author: main agent
independence: not independent holdout; authors and preparation reviewers know the cases

cases.scope: Only the nominated contract; not a claim that the source is generally defect-free.
cases.evidence_method: static source analysis and historical repair; no Rust/browser/model execution
cases.cause: Unframed concatenation feeds identical bytes Rp123x to SHA-256 for distinct field tuples. This is encoding ambiguity, not a cryptographic SHA collision.
cases.consequence: Distinct occurrences can share a finding ID and downstream associations; do not attribute the separate colon-based dedup defect to this excerpt.
cases.fixed_reason: native_id frames domain/version, part count and every UTF-8 part length before hashing.
cases.acceptable_finding: Explain at least one concrete distinct-tuple encoding collision; delimiter-free hashing ambiguity is sufficient.
cases.reject_as_target: Speculation that truncated SHA alone proves an actual collision, general hasher replacement, absolute-root behavior not supplied here.
cases.expected_response: One actionable finding identifying the nominated historical root cause; duplicates count separately as overhead.

cases.cause: Only the first physical line gets the four-space code indentation; embedded continuation lines can become Markdown/HTML structure.
cases.consequence: Attacker-controlled source text can escape code presentation. Active HTML depends on the consuming renderer; this preparation does not demonstrate script execution.
cases.fixed_reason: md_code normalizes CRLF and CR to LF and indents every continuation before interpolation.
cases.acceptable_finding: Identify unindented embedded newlines at the source snippet formatting call, with a concrete rendering integrity consequence.
cases.reject_as_target: Claiming HTML escaping is always required inside an indented block, or asserting browser XSS execution without renderer evidence.
cases.expected_response: One actionable finding identifying the nominated historical root cause; duplicates count separately as overhead.

cases.cause: Always serializing native coordinate zero as SARIF startLine/startColumn invents an invalid position instead of representing unknown.
cases.consequence: SARIF consumers can reject the result or receive misleading source locations.
cases.fixed_reason: An unknown line omits region; sarif_column returns None for column zero and serde skips it, preserving a known line.
cases.acceptable_finding: Explain unknown-zero serialization for either line or column; combine both as one coordinate-projection root cause.
cases.reject_as_target: URI escaping, columnKind, unrelated schema properties or unsupported AST policy outside the nominated scope.
cases.expected_response: One actionable finding identifying the nominated historical root cause; duplicates count separately as overhead.
